# Combobox

Searchable select for long lists — images, profiles, projects, networks, cluster members.

`KenosUI.Combobox` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Combobox options={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Combobox" options="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Searchable select (ARIA combobox): type to filter (accents ignored, prefix matches first), ↑↓ Enter Esc, groups, descriptions, multi-select as Tags. List in the top layer.
